campaign.title: 2022 campaign financial framework · CityNews
campaign.locator: Paragraph beginning Central to Sutcliffe’s financial framework
campaign.review_note: Contemporary reporting distinguishes the 2023–24 limit from the 2025–26 target. The opening paragraph has a conflicting five-per-cent typo; the title and detailed framework specify 2.5%. Original campaign platform archive not obtained.

review2023.title: CBC first-term promise review · republished by Yahoo
review2023.review_note: Retrospective confirmation of adopted 2.5% increases in both 2023 and 2024; secondary source, cross-checked against City 2023 draft and councillor 2024 adoption account.

city2023.title: City of Ottawa · 2023 draft budget at a glance
city2023.locator: Working together for a better Ottawa; Overall affordability
city2023.review_note: Primary source for the proposed 2.5% overall increase; draft only, so final adoption is separately confirmed by CBC.

adopted2024.title: Councillor Rawlson King · adopted 2024 budget
adopted2024.locator: A Message from Councillor King, first paragraph
adopted2024.review_note: Council member’s contemporary account of approval on December 6 and 2.5% increase.

adopted2025.title: Councillor Rawlson King · adopted 2025 budget
adopted2025.locator: Opening budget summary and overall tax increase paragraph
adopted2025.review_note: 3.9% overall; 2.9% citywide and police, with transit levy contributing the additional overall percentage point. Also cross-checked against December 11 CityNews adoption report.

adopted2026.title: City of Ottawa · Council approves Ottawa’s 2026 Budget
adopted2026.review_note: Adoption announcement states 3.75% overall net tax increase. Archived City page.

history.title: City of Ottawa · historical annual tax increases, 2013–2023
history.locator: Annual property tax increase table, Ottawa row, 2013–2023 columns
history.review_note: Manually transcribed City-published series: 2013 2.09%; 2014 1.91%; 2015–2018 2.00%; 2019–2022 3.00%; 2023 2.50%. Published municipal budget comparison, not individual bills. Earlier years provide context only.

annual_cpi.title: Statistics Canada · annual Ottawa all-items CPI
annual_cpi.review_note: Annual percentage changes calculated from annual average index levels. Baseline 2012 retained. Inputs, formula and response hash in inflation.json.

monthly_cpi.title: Statistics Canada · monthly Ottawa all-items CPI
monthly_cpi.locator: Same geography and all-items coordinate as annual table
monthly_cpi.review_note: 2026 compares the January–September average with the same months in 2025; not with the full 2025 average. Provisional partial-year measure, not full-year inflation.
